### {{< var pi.name >}} {#gyula-kovacs}

::: {.person-role}
{{< var pi.role >}}, {{< var org.short >}}
:::

Leads the department's research on the neural background of perceptual and cognitive functions, including object and person recognition, the interaction between perception and memory, and predictive neural processes. The work combines electrophysiology, functional imaging, and transcranial magnetic stimulation.

::: {.person-links}
[Learn more]({{< var contact.department_url >}})
:::

:::

:::


::: {.person}

<img class="person-photo" src="/assets/people/mario-archila.jpeg" alt="Portrait of Dr. Mario Archila">


::: {.person-body}

### Dr. Mario Archila {#mario-archila}

::: {.person-role}
Researcher and Lecturer in Neuro-AI and Visual Perception
:::

Works at the interface of cognitive neuroscience and machine learning, applying computational methods to neural and behavioural data. Leads the Translational Neuro-AI research program within BPCN.

::: {.person-links}
[Learn more]({{< var links.archila >}})
:::

:::
